originalTitle: Chris vs Chris: Who's running and what's at stake this New Zealand election
summary: New Zealanders will head to the polls on 7 November to elect a new government, with rising cost of living a key concern for voters.
content:
New Zealanders will head to the polls on 7 November to elect a new government. The rising cost of living, unemployment and healthcare are among the key concerns of voters.

The BBC's Australia and New Zealand correspondent, Katy Watson, explains everything you need to know.

Read more about the New Zealand election here .
chineseTitle: 克里斯 vs 克里斯：谁参加竞选以及这次新西兰选举的利害关系
chineseSummary: 新西兰人将于 11 月 7 日投票选举新政府，生活成本上升是选民的主要担忧。
chineseContent:
新西兰人将于 11 月 7 日前往投票站选举新政府。生活成本、失业和医疗保健成本不断上升是选民最关心的问题。
